translation: Avoid wind, cold, and cold things; guard against anger and vexation. <ins>Da Shen Xiao Huo Luo Dan (大神效活絡丹)</ins> This elixir spreads and frees qi and blood, unblocks the channels and collaterals, and treats wind-damp bi (痹) conditions, deviation of the mouth and eyes, hemiplegia, difficulty in walking, contraction of sinews and bones, and pain of the hands and feet, and similar conditions. White-flowered snake (白花蛇, soaked in wine, baked), black-striped snake (烏梢蛇, soaked in wine, baked), ephedra (麻黃, nodes removed), saposhnikovia (防風), honey-fried licorice (炙草), cassia bark (官桂), caodoukou (草豆蔻), notopterygium (羌活), scrophularia (元參), gastrodia (天麻), patchouli (藿香), fleeceflower root (何首烏), angelica dahurica (白芷), Sichuan coptis (川連黃, each two liang), astragalus (黃耆), cooked rehmannia (熟地黃), Sichuan rhubarb (川大黃), Liaoning asarum (遼細辛), red peony (赤芍藥), cinnabar (硃砂, water-ground), myrrh (沒藥, de-oiled), frankincense (乳香, de-oiled), stiff silkworm (直殭蠶, black mouth removed, stir-fried), bamboo shavings (天竺黃), baked turtle shell (敗龜板, baked with su), clove (丁香), tiger shin bone (虎脛骨, baked with su), lindera (烏藥), green tangerine peel (青皮), black aconite (黑附子), white cardamom kernel (白蔻仁, stir-fried), drynaria (骨碎補), white poria (白茯苓), atractylodes (於白朮, earth-stir-fried), Chinese angelica (當歸, washed in wine), agarwood (沉香, each one liang), scorpion (全蠍, toxin removed), pueraria (葛根), clematis (威靈仙, soaked in wine, each two liang five qian), Gua'er dragon's blood (瓜兒血竭), rhinoceros horn (犀角, each seven qian five fen), musk (麝香, five qian), earthworm (地龍, soil removed, five qian), purified rosin (淨松香, five qian), liangtoujian (兩頭尖), chuanxiong (川芎, each two liang), Beijing bezoar (京牛黃, two qian five fen), borneol (片腦, two qian five fen). Grind all together into a red powder, refine honey into pills, coated with gold leaf.
